verdict.rationale: Riskified documents a public REST API that can be called directly over HTTP. It has concrete endpoints for order decisions (/decide, /submit, /advise), chargebacks and login, plus documented HMAC request authentication, optional SDKs, and an llms.txt with markdown docs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Riskified API is a REST-based API that supports direct integration using standard HTTP requests.
all API endpoints can also be accessed directly using HTTP requests.
The `/decide` endpoint is used to request that Riskified review an order for fraud after the customer has input their payment data and completed the purchase.
